To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

TEXTRUNNER is a fully implemented system that extracts a broad and rich set of relational tuples from Web corpora with a single pass over its corpus, and that TEXTRUNNERS performance is superior to KNOWITALL on the same task.
TEXTRUNNER is able to extract 33% fewer errors than KNOWITALL, while extracting a far broader set (over 11,000 more relations) of facts (over 1,000 more concrete facts) than KNOWITALL.

OIE is a new paradigm for IE that can be used to extract far more information than previous systems, and that TEXTRUNNER is the first OIE system that can extract this information at a scale that makes it useful.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of how to extract a large number of relational tuples from a Web corpus without requiring human input, and how to index these tuples to support efficient exploration via user queries
building a system that can extract a large number of facts from the Web, without requiring any human supervision.
developing a new extraction paradigm that scales to the Web and is applicable to a wide range of domains.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
OIE is a promising new paradigm that can scale far beyond what is possible with traditional IE.
Open IE is a new paradigm for IE that can scale to a broad range of domains and relations without requiring human effort.
TEXTRUNNER is the first system capable of extracting a large number of facts and assertions from a large corpus of Web pages.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present the first fully automated, scalable, and open domain Information Extraction system.
we present a system which extracts facts from a large amount of data without any human supervision.
OIE systems are a step towards the vision of a Web that is not only a source of documents, but a source of knowledge.
The main takeaway from our work is that
OIE is a promising new IE paradigm that can be applied to a wide variety of domains.
a single pass, data driven approach to extraction, without human input, is a viable and scalable alternative to the traditional rule based and training based approaches.
a single pass over the Web yields a wealth of information, and that the OIE paradigm is a powerful and practical way to access it.
